div.div: رَعَاوَى and رُعَاوَى Camels that pasture around the people and their dwellings (S, K) because they are those upon which they work [or perform their business]: (S:) but in the Tekmileh it is written ↓ رُعَاوِيَّةٌ , as meaning cattle that pasture around the dwellings of the people. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
